get.summary: Reports whether the API and its dependencies are reachable.

post.description: The slug comes from the name; two categories cannot share a slug.
The slug comes from the name and never changes. The response carries the version to send on the next change.

get.summary: Lists every product by name, 50 per page, including products without SKUs.
get.description: page starts at 1; hasNextPage tells whether page + 1 has products.

get.summary: Gets a product with its SKUs and current version.

put.summary: Updates a product's category, name, description and attributes.
put.description: Send the version last read; a stale version answers 409 catalog.product_changed. The slug does not change.

post.summary: Adds a SKU (a variant such as color and size) with its price to a product.
post.description: Send the product version last read; a stale version answers 409 catalog.product_changed. Prices are in BRL.

put.summary: Changes the price of one SKU.
put.description: Send the product version last read; a stale version answers 409 catalog.product_changed. Prices are in BRL.

post.summary: Starts a product image upload: returns a presigned PUT URL.
post.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB. PUT the file to uploadUrl with the same Content-Type before expiresAt (5 minutes), then attach it with POST /images and the key.

post.summary: Attaches an uploaded image to the product, after its other images.
post.description: Send the key from /images/uploads, the colour the image shows (the cor value of the coloured SKU it shows; leave it out, or send null, only for an image of a SKU without cor) and the product version last read. The stored file is checked again: a wrong type or a file over 2 MB is deleted (400 catalog.invalid_image). A colour no SKU has is 400 catalog.image_color_not_found; a colour has at most 8 images (409 catalog.image_limit). The same key again with the same colour answers the current version; with another colour it is 409 catalog.duplicate_image. A new image sent with a stale version is 409 catalog.product_changed.

delete.summary: Removes an image from the product.
delete.description: fileName is the last segment of the image key; version is the product version last read.

get.summary: Searches and lists the products that have at least one SKU.
get.description: q finds words with or without accents, in the singular or the plural, and name words with a small typo (longer words tolerate more). attribute=key:value can repeat (one per key) and matches a single SKU. sort is relevance (the default: by relevance with q, newest first without), price_asc or price_desc (by priceAmount, ties by id). priceAmount is the lowest price among the SKUs that match; hasPriceRange tells whether those SKUs have different prices. imageUrl is a signed URL of the product's first image (the cover), valid for an hour, or null. colors lists every colour of the product's SKUs (the cor attribute): colours with images first, in the order of their first image, then the others by name; each imageUrl is that colour's first image or null. Pass nextCursor as after, with the same filters and sort, to read the next page; drop after whenever the filters or the sort change (only its syntax is checked).

get.summary: Counts the products of a search per category, price range and attribute value.
get.description: Takes the q, category, minPrice, maxPrice and attribute of the product search. Every count is the number of products the search returns for that refinement. A price range is minAmount ≤ price < maxAmount (no upper bound when maxAmount is null); to list it, send minPrice = the larger of minAmount and the current minPrice, and maxPrice = the smaller of maxAmount−0.01 and the current maxPrice (leave out a bound that is absent on both sides).

get.summary: Suggests up to 8 product names for the text typed so far.
get.description: q takes 2 to 50 characters. Accents and case are ignored, and names that start with q come first.

get.summary: Gets a product page by slug: category, attributes and SKUs with prices.
get.description: A product without SKUs is not for sale yet and answers 404, as does a slug in any other spelling. imageUrls is the whole gallery, cover first; colors lists every colour of the SKUs (the cor attribute), colours with images first in the order of their first image, then the others by name, each with its own image URLs. Image URLs are signed and valid for an hour.

post.description: Creates an account with the customer role. The password needs 8 to 128 characters. Log in afterwards to get tokens.

post.summary: Logs in with e-mail and password.
post.description: Returns a 15-minute access token and a 7-day refresh token. Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes. Attempts are rate limited per client IP.

post.summary: Trades a refresh token for a new token pair.
post.description: Each refresh token works once. Presenting one that was already traded ends every session started from the same login. Send one refresh at a time per session.

post.summary: Ends the session of a refresh token.
post.description: Revokes the refresh token and every token rotated from the same login; other logins of the user keep working. Answers 204 for unknown or already revoked tokens too. An access token already issued stays valid until it expires (15 minutes).

get.description: Read from the access token, without a database read: a role change shows after the next refresh.

get.summary: Gets the customer's basket with the price seen when each item was added and the current price.
get.description: hasPriceChanged flags items whose price changed since they were added; the subtotal uses current prices of available items. Send that subtotal as expectedSubtotalAmount at checkout. color, size and imageUrl come from the catalog when the basket is read (imageUrl is the first image of the SKU's colour, or for a SKU without colour the first image without colour, never another colour's; signed for an hour); each is null when the SKU or the value is missing.

post.summary: Adds a SKU to the basket.
post.description: Adding a SKU already in the basket sums the quantities (at most 10 per item) and keeps today's price.

put.summary: Changes the quantity of a basket item.
put.description: Quantity 1 to 10; to remove an item use DELETE.

delete.summary: Removes an item from the basket.
delete.description: Answers 204 also when the item is not in the basket.

get.summary: Gets the stock of the given SKUs.
get.description: Repeat skuId (at most 100). A SKU without stock has no row. held counts the units of committed or unexpired reservations; available is onHand minus held.

put.summary: Sets the on-hand units of a SKU.
put.description: Creates the stock of a SKU that has none. onHand cannot drop below the units held by reservations (409 inventory.below_held_units).

post.summary: Places an order from the customer's basket (checkout).
post.description: Send a new Idempotency-Key header per checkout attempt; repeating a key returns the same order. expectedSubtotalAmount is the basket subtotal the customer saw: a different current subtotal answers 409 ordering.price_changed. The order starts as Placed; poll GET /orders/{id} until Confirmed or Cancelled. The fake gateway declines the token tok_decline.

get.summary: Lists the customer's orders, newest first.
Gets one of the customer's orders with its lines, totals and status timeline.

post.summary: Cancels a confirmed order: the stock is released and the payment refunded.
post.description: Only Confirmed orders can be cancelled (409 ordering.order_not_cancellable otherwise).

get.summary: Lists every customer's orders, newest first.
get.description: status filters by Placed, Confirmed, Cancelled or Shipped. limit is 1 to 100 (default 50). Pass nextCursor as after to read the next page.

post.summary: Ships a confirmed order: its reserved units leave the stock.
post.description: Only Confirmed orders can be shipped (409 ordering.order_not_shippable otherwise); a shipped order can no longer be cancelled.
